pages.title: Raw Anti-Iron
pages.text: It looks exactly like iron ore in the Antiverse and exactly like a bomb anywhere else. Kept in a Penning field it is perfectly docile.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Broken out of the antistone in the Antiverse. The harness kept me whole; my pickaxe did not survive.

Made in $(item)Mirror Matter Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Anti-Iron Ore$(), in veins through the Antiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Antiverse Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): CPT Symmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anti-Iron Ingot.
